AI evaluation fixtures belong in this directory.

Place representative jewelry images supplied by the product owner here and keep them
out of source control if they are sensitive or licensed separately.

Suggested naming:
- `ring-01.jpg`
- `necklace-01.png`
- `bracelet-01.webp`

Use these files for offline evaluation and regression review of the AI analysis
pipeline. The automated test suite does not depend on these assets.
